test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How much amount can a person get on a sum of Rs. 6,600, if it is invested at 6.2% per annum for a period of 2 years 6 months on simple interest?
solution:
Given:

Principal amount = Rs. 6000

Rate of interest = 6.2% p.a. 

Time = 2 years 6 months = 2.5 years

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Now, after 2.5 years, the person will get

⇒ 6600 + (6600 × 6.2 × 2.5)/100

⇒ 6600 + 1023

⇒ Rs. 7623

∴ He can get Rs. 7,623.
